title: Expensive computed selectors run every render
summary: Framework selectors, computed values, or pipes recompute expensive transformations unnecessarily.
rationale: Repeated transformations in render paths waste CPU and can scale poorly with data size.

impact.notes: Impact increases on high-traffic routes, large datasets, frequently rendered pages, or repeated background work.

remediation.guidance: Memoize bounded computations, precompute server-side when appropriate, and avoid heavy work in render paths.
remediation.tradeoffs: Framework conventions, readability, caching correctness, and deployment topology should be considered before changing behavior.
